map.秦汉官印多用铜(青铜)，私印有玉、铜、银；唐宋以后石印(寿山石、青田石)普及；明: Qin and Han official seals were mostly copper (bronze), while private seals used jade, copper and silver; after the Tang and Song, stone seals (Shoushan stone, Qingtian stone) became widespread; Ming and Qing literati seals are mainly stone, also with jade, ivory and wood.
map.秦汉印钮有等级之分——鼻钮(低级)、瓦钮、坛钮、龟钮(高级)、驼钮；唐宋以后印钮: Qin and Han seal knobs are ranked — nose knob (low grade), tile knob, altar knob, turtle knob (high grade), camel knob; after the Tang and Song knobs became simpler; Ming and Qing stone seal knob craft flourished (animal knobs, thin relief carving).
map.秦印用秦篆(小篆)，界格分明；汉印用缪篆(汉篆)，方正端庄；唐宋印文多楷书、隶书: Qin seals use Qin seal script (small seal script) with clear grid lines; Han seals use miaozhuan (Han seal script), square and dignified; Tang and Song seal texts are mostly regular or clerical script; Ming and Qing school seals have varied styles.
map.秦汉多为白文(阴文，字凹)；唐宋以后朱文(阳文，字凸)增多；明清朱白并用。朱白与: Qin and Han are mostly baiwen (intaglio, characters recessed); after the Tang and Song zhuwen (relief, characters raised) increased; Ming and Qing use both. The choice is related to period and material (copper seals suit intaglio, stone seals suit relief).
map.官印(政权信物)、私印(个人凭信)、书画鉴藏印、闲章(诗词格言)。官印有严格制度: Official seals (tokens of authority), private seals (personal credentials), painting and calligraphy collection seals, leisure seals (poetry and maxims). Official seals follow a strict system and are an important dating basis. This table is for reference and learning.

map.以印钮与印文区分汉官印与明清文人印: Distinguishing Han official seals from Ming-Qing literati seals by knob and seal text
map.汉官印多为铜质凿铸，印文用缪篆、方整端严，印钮常见瓦钮、龟钮；明清文人印转向寿山: Han official seals are mostly chisel-cast copper, with seal text in miaozhuan, square and strictly structured, and knobs commonly in tile, turtle and similar forms; Ming and Qing literati seals turned to stone such as Shoushan and Qingtian, with seal text pursuing free expression (such as the schools of Wen Peng and Deng Shiru) and knob work often carved as ancient beasts. A turtle-knob copper seal with miaozhuan most likely points to the Han and Wei official seal system.
map.秦汉印章的\"缪篆\"是什么，如何辨认？: What is "miaozhuan" on Qin and Han seals, and how is it recognized?
map.缪篆是汉代用于印章的篆书变体，笔画屈曲、方正填满印面以适应方形构图。辨认看结体是: Miaozhuan is a variant of seal script used for seals in the Han dynasty, with curved strokes packed squarely into the seal face to suit a square composition. Recognition looks at whether the structure is square, whether the strokes curve and coil evenly, distinguishing it from the Qin "mo yin zhuan" and from later nine-fold seal script (the complex folded style of Song, Jin and Yuan official seals).
map.石质印章如何区分天然包浆与人工做旧？: How can natural patina be distinguished from artificial distressing on stone seals?
map.老坑印石包浆温润、受刀处与自然磨损连贯；人工做旧常用药蚀、烧烤制造斑驳，痕迹生硬: Old-mine seal stone has a warm patina, and the cut areas connect naturally with the wear; artificial distressing usually uses chemical etching or scorching to create a mottled look, and the traces are stiff and unnaturally distributed, with contradictions often appearing between fresh cut surfaces and breaks in the old skin.
